rules.statement: A co-owner's long-term exclusive possession of a portion of land can be presumed to have become adverse after a certain period, especially if the other co-owners acquiesce in such possession.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is a question of fact, whenever long continued exclusive possession by one co-owner is proved to have existed, whether it is not just and reasonable in all the circumstances of the case that the parties should be treated as though it had been proved that separate and exclusive possession had become adverse at some date more than ten years before action was brought."

meta.parties: Livinis Silva and Another v. William Fernando and Another
